experiment.name: track_ot_pp_fold1_full_recovered_s42
experiment.notes: Full TRACK-OT++ training run on RTX 5070 in FP32 with warm-start weights from recovery pilot (best.pt @ Val AP 0.9207). Disclosed as continuation using weights only with fresh optimizer and cosine schedule. Validated Rail-VIVID source, guarded folds (val: 4, test: 1,2,3), spatial leakage controls, and test set held out until frozen.
